caption: A rich, creamy tonkotsu ramen broth glistens in a white bowl, topped with shredded cabbage and green onions. The red-and-white tray with “とちんばん” printed on it rests on a warm, softly lit surface.

segments_info.text: Red tray with white "とちんばん" text, smooth surface, rectangular shape with slightly raised edges.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is rich, amber-brown, and glossy, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with red geometric pattern and black "とちんばん" text on its rim.
